name: eight-hour-block-hourly-spacing-band-0125
rationale: Mandatory trading-cost hypothesis (16th consecutive negative static-mix run). 2026-10-13 lead #3: with 8h block / 1h spacing / rsi60/bb90 fixed, the 500,000 JPY static-mix Sharpe deficit went -0.51 (band 0.10) -> -0.20 (0.15) -> -1.12 (0.20) on one window, and band 0.15 reached +0.004 at 5M. 0.125 is a lower-side dose point between the two best values to test whether the 0.15 optimum is a smooth interior peak or path-dependent noise. At 50,000 JPY any band below ~0.25 is inert, so the primary verdict is not evidence about the band; the diagnostic capitals are.
